details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. Activate only if there are 0 cards in your hand. [fanfare] Put the top card of your deck into your EX area. Discard a card.

issues: The hand-empty condition is applied to the fanfare, but the source text says it applies only to the [evolve] ability. Remove the `handMax: 0` condition from the fanfare ability and encode the evolve ability instead.

The card is missing its implementable evolve activated ability. Add a `timing: "evolve"` ability with cost `{ "pp": 1 }` and condition `{ "type": "handMax", "count": 0 }` to represent "[evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. Activate only if there are 0 cards in your hand."

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: On Evolve - Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 5 damage to it, 2 damage to its leader, give your leader [defense]+2, and put the top card of your deck into your EX area.

issues: The On Evolve effect incorrectly lets you choose any enemy follower for 5 damage and then deals 2 damage to any enemy leader separately. It should target a single enemy follower and deal 5 damage to that follower and 2 damage to its leader in the same linked effect; use `damageFollowerAndLeader` instead of separate `dealDamage` steps.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: This doesn't take ability damage. Strike - Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. Give your leader [defense]+2. [act] [cost02]: Give this Storm.

issues: The Strike ability is encoded as `dealDamageAllEnemies` for 2, which damages enemy followers and the enemy leader. The source says "Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader" only; replace that step with `dealDamage` targeting `{ "type": "enemyLeader" }` for 2.
